title: Low-Depth Initial-State Preparation for Ground-State Energy Estimation of Two-Dimensional Strongly Correlated Systems
summary: Quantum algorithms for ground-state energy estimation require initial states with non-negligible fidelity to the ground state. Guided by classical simulations, we design shallow circuits for the two-dimensional half-filled Hubbard model by first preparing an approximate Heisenberg ground state and then applying charge-fluctuation gates derived directly from the Schrieffer-Wolff (SW) generator.
